_avail.description: Axient Digital PSM Wireless Dual Transmitter
_avail.note: ADTDE: 100-240 V AC, 1.2 A max (6.2 A with AC outlet loaded); W not published. ADTDDC: 12-48 V DC, 10.1 A max, 4.9 kg. Datasheet URL = PDF of official user guide (no separate spec sheet linked).

portsSource.note: p.9-11 ADTQ/ADTD front and back panel; p.25-27 preset antennas; p.81-82 specifications

_avail.portsMissing: The ADPSM guide gives no connector counts or panel labels: audio inputs derived as one L/R combo pair per channel and antenna outputs from the preset text (ADTQ 4, ADTD 2). Front-panel 3.5 mm monitor jack is not modelled.

ports.label: Audio In 1 L
ports.notes: Channel 1 left; combo XLR / 1/4" TRS, balanced, +4 dBu / -10 dBV; AES3 on XLR when the rear input switch is set to AES3; either jack for mono

ports.label: Audio In 1 R
ports.notes: Channel 1 right; combo XLR / 1/4" TRS, balanced, +4 dBu / -10 dBV; AES3 on XLR when the rear input switch is set to AES3; either jack for mono

ports.label: Audio In 2 L
ports.notes: Channel 2 left; combo XLR / 1/4" TRS, balanced, +4 dBu / -10 dBV; AES3 on XLR when the rear input switch is set to AES3; either jack for mono

ports.label: Audio In 2 R
ports.notes: Channel 2 right; combo XLR / 1/4" TRS, balanced, +4 dBu / -10 dBV; AES3 on XLR when the rear input switch is set to AES3; either jack for mono

ports.label: Antenna Out A
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm transmit antenna output; Band G56 470-636 MHz

ports.label: Antenna Out B
ports.notes: BNC, 50 ohm transmit antenna output; Band G56 470-636 MHz

ports.label: IEM (Wireless)
ports.notes: Wireless link to ADXR bodypack receivers (up to 2 stereo channels, licence dependent); Band G56 470-636 MHz

ports.label: AC Power In
ports.notes: IEC locking, 100-240 V AC 50-60 Hz, 1.2 A max (6.2 A max with the outlet loaded)

ports.label: AC Power Out (Cascade)
ports.notes: Locking IEC outlet, 100-240 V AC, 5 A max, unswitched
